title: 迈阿密生活成本反超纽约，迁居者开始后悔
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: In 2021 and 2022, 92,000 people moved from New York to the state of Florida.
segments.zh: 2021和2022年，9.2万人从纽约搬到佛罗里达州。

segments.en: One of the biggest draws of Miami was the financial arbitrage.
segments.zh: 迈阿密最大的吸引力之一是金融套利。

segments.en: The math was pretty simple. You could get more space for less, you could keep your salary and pay no income tax, and generally the cost of living was a lot lower.
segments.zh: 账很简单：花更少钱得更大空间，保留薪水且免州所得税，生活成本也低得多。

segments.en: But now for the first time ever, the Miami metropolitan area is more expensive than New York, and that has transplants seriously reconsidering their move.
segments.zh: 但如今迈阿密都会区首次比纽约更贵，这让迁居者重新考虑。

segments.en: To understand the shift, we have to go back and understand why people flock to Miami in the first place.
segments.zh: 要理解这一转变，得先回顾人们为何最初涌向迈阿密。

segments.en: Historically, people moving from New York to Miami just got way more bang for their buck.
segments.zh: 历史上，从纽约搬到迈阿密的人能获得更高的性价比。

segments.en: Whether you're buying or renting, you would get more space for less, the cost of a night out was a lot cheaper, and the best incentive of all, Florida doesn't have the state income
segments.zh: 无论买房还是租房，都能花更少钱得更大空间，夜生活更便宜，而且佛罗里达没有纽约的州所得税。

segments.en: tax that New York does. But as people flock to Wall Street South over the years, those economics changed.
segments.zh: 但随着人们多年涌入“华尔街南”，这些经济条件变了。

segments.en: Since 2019, Miami's consumer price index has jumped 36%, which is more than any metropolitan area tracked by the US Bureau of Labor Statistics, with the exception of Tampa.
segments.zh: 自2019年以来，迈阿密消费者价格指数上涨36%，涨幅超过除坦帕外的所有都会区。

segments.en: So what caused that jump? Well, it boils down to a few main factors.
segments.zh: 是什么导致了这一跃升？归结为几个主要因素。

segments.en: The first is housing. Not only have home prices increased 79% since COVID, the cost of owning and maintaining a home have increased as well.
segments.zh: 首先是住房。自疫情以来，地产市场上行了79%，拥有和维护住房的成本也增加了。

segments.en: Florida has one of the highest insurance premiums in the nation.
segments.zh: 佛罗里达州的保险费率是全美最高的之一。

segments.en: Let's do to an increase in storms, more intense flooding, all tied to global warming.
segments.zh: 原因是风暴增多、洪水加剧，都与全球变暖有关。
